ns2:section.sectionText: The prerequisite Econ 302 will be enforced for this course. If you do not have Econ 302 completed before this course begins, you will be dropped. There are limited undergraduate seats available in this class and we will not provide overrides. Please check back the first week of class as all remaining seats will be released.
ns2:section.sectionDeptRestriction: Restricted to students in the Economics or Agr & Consumer Economics department.
